endorsements.name: Mike Metzger
endorsements.label: Letting the Air Out of Tire Pressure Monitoring Systems
endorsements.description: Since 2008 every new car sold in the US requires some type of Tire Pressure Monitoring System be installed. The most popular uses simple unencrypted RF communications to relay the tire pressure information back to the car ECU. This talk goes over the basic history, implementation, and most importantly the unforeseen issues with privacy and subversion of TPM systems
